readingTheCounts: A member count proves that at least one line in the named range executed. The reach command additionally fails on any cold executable whole line inside a reached range. JavaScript line coverage cannot distinguish every ternary, nullish, optional-chain, or compound-condition operand sharing one physical line, so the report's cold sub-line regions and focused helper/delegation tests must be read alongside this differential proof.
